macros.name: aanwezig
macros.doc: Use \aanwezig{names} to take note of who is present at the meeting.

macros.name: adviezenlijst
macros.doc: Use \adviezenlijst to generate a table of contents.

macros.name: adviezenlijst*
macros.doc: Use \adviezenlijst to generate a table of contents.

macros.name: afwezig
macros.doc: To mark names as absent, use \afwezig{naam3, naam4} .

macros.name: ap
macros.doc: Use \ap{name}{task} to assign a task (“actiepunt”) to a name.

macros.name: aplijstpp
macros.doc: \aplijstpp produces a list of tasks sorted by whom they are assigned to.

macros.name: aplijstpp*
macros.doc: \aplijstpp produces a list of tasks sorted by whom they are assigned to.

macros.name: korteapnaam
macros.doc: It is possible to define macros for names using \korteapnaam{macro}{name}.

macros.name: naam
macros.doc: \naam{name} displays a name slanted, e.g., \naam{Bob} would return Bob.

macros.name: naamzet
macros.doc: \naamzet outputs a list of present (and potentially absent) names.

macros.name: noitemsep
macros.doc: This removes the vertical spacing between items in lists, such as itemize or enumerate.

macros.name: opm
macros.doc: \opm{comment} adds a comment, which will be smaller and emphasized.
